scope: Corollary B.7 (True cuts converge at packet ends) of the manuscript “Positive scalar curvature and uniform codimension-two width” (preprints/Positive-scalar-curvature-and-uniform-codimension-two-width-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 336 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f67c30579306bd4d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 64. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the common generic shift, let AE be the true phase on each packet and let AB be that on a face. On translated windows escaping in a product collar over a compact part of B, the phases AE converge to AB × Rd in L1 loc, their perimeter measures and varifolds converge, and their regular boundaries converge smoothly on compact sets off the limiting singular set. Their boundary supports converge locally as well. The same conclusions hold after passage to any deeper product furnished by Theorem A.3.
